readme_excerpt: Docling What is Docling ? Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats — including advanced PDF understanding — and providing seamless integrations with the generative AI ecosystem. Features - 🗂️ Parsing of [multiple document formats][supportedformats] including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, Apple Pages, WAV, MP3, WebVTT, Box Notes, email formats (EML, MSG), images (PNG, TIFF, JPEG, ...), LaTeX, DocLang, plain text, and more - 📑 Advanced PDF understanding incl. page…
